/** One-off: records what main (6027e7c) stores for rule-matched imports. Not part of any branch. */
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { Hono } from 'hono';

import { contracts } from '../catalog';
import { pool } from '../core/db';
import { dbReady } from '../core/test-gate';
import { makeOpCaller } from '../core/test-op';
import { httpOnError } from '../core/validate';
import type { IdentityUser } from '../user';
import budget from '../budget';
import * as store from './store';
import { syncConnectionTransactions } from './sync';
import type { AggregatedTransaction, BankAggregator } from './types';

const PROVIDER = 'testprovider-capture';
const user: IdentityUser = { id: crypto.randomUUID(), email: 'capture@syscd.local', googleSub: null, role: 'user', status: 'active' };
const app = new Hono();
app.onError(httpOnError);
app.use('*', (c, next) => { c.set('user', user); return next(); });
app.route('/', budget);
const op = makeOpCaller(app, contracts);

const B = crypto.randomUUID();
const itau = crypto.randomUUID();
const nubank = crypto.randomUUID();
const third = crypto.randomUUID();
const savings = crypto.randomUUID();
const EXT_ITEM = `up-item-cap-${user.id}`;
const EXT_ITAU = 'up-acc-cap-itau';
const date = new Date(Date.now() - 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

const TEXTS: [string, number][] = [
  ['PADOCA 42', -10000],
  ['UBER *TRIP 123', -2000],
  ['PADDED RAW', -3000],
  ['NETFLIX.COM', -4000],
  ['PIX SAV 42', -5000],
  ['PIX THIRD', -6000],
  ['Corner Shop', -7000],
  ['Transfer : Nubank Conta', -8000],
  ['MERCADO LIVRE SP', -9000],
  ['pix sav', -11000],
  ['padoca', -12000],
  ['  Bakery  ', -13000],
];

let upstream: AggregatedTransaction[] = [];
const aggregator = {
  environment: 'production',
  listTransactions: async () => ({ transactions: upstream.map((t) => ({ ...t })), hasMore: false }),
  fetchInstitution: async () => null,
} as unknown as BankAggregator;
let connId = '';
const sync = () => syncConnectionTransactions({ userId: user.id, connectionId: connId, aggregator, ignoreWatermark: true });

describe.skipIf(!dbReady)('capture', () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    await pool.query(`INSERT INTO users (id, google_sub, email, role, status) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'user','active')`, [user.id, user.id, user.email]);
    await pool.query('INSERT INTO budgets (id, name, owner_user_id) VALUES ($1,$2,$3)', [B, 'capture', user.id]);
    await pool.query('INSERT INTO budget_members (budget_id, user_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING', [B, user.id]);
    await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO accounts (id, budget_id, name, type, account_group, on_budget) VALUES
       ($1,$5,'Itau Conta','checking','CASH',true),($2,$5,'Nubank Conta','checking','CASH',true),
       ($3,$5,'Third Conta','checking','CASH',true),($4,$5,'Savings Conta','checking','CASH',true)`,
      [itau, nubank, third, savings, B],
    );
    for (const [id, name] of [[itau, 'Itau Conta'], [nubank, 'Nubank Conta'], [third, 'Third Conta'], [savings, 'Savings Conta']] as const) {
      const p = await pool.query<{ id: string }>('INSERT INTO payees (budget_id, name, transfer_account_id) VALUES ($1,$2,$3) RETURNING id', [B, `Transfer : ${name}`, id]);
      await pool.query('UPDATE accounts SET transfer_payee_id = $1 WHERE id = $2', [p.rows[0]!.id, id]);
    }
    // Rules, one per payee (main's schema), created in this order.
    const rule = async (name: string, type: string, cond: string, transferAccount: string | null = null) => {
      if (transferAccount) {
        await pool.query('UPDATE payees SET rename_match_type = $2, rename_condition = $3 WHERE budget_id = $1 AND transfer_account_id = $4', [B, type, cond, transferAccount]);
      } else {
        await pool.query('INSERT INTO payees (budget_id, name, rename_match_type, rename_condition) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)', [B, name, type, cond]);
      }
    };
    await rule('Padaria', 'contains', 'PADOCA');
    await rule('Uber', 'contains', 'UBER');
    await rule(' Padded ', 'is', 'PADDED RAW');
    await rule('Netflix', 'is', 'NETFLIX.COM');
    await rule('', 'contains', 'PIX SAV', nubank);
    await rule('', 'is', 'PIX THIRD', third);
    await rule('Mercado', 'contains', 'MERC');
    await rule('Mercado Livre', 'contains', 'MERCADO LIVRE');
    const c = await store.upsertConnection({ userId: user.id, provider: PROVIDER, externalId: EXT_ITEM, clientUserId: `cu-${user.id}`, status: 'connected', environment: 'production' });
    connId = c.id;
    await pool.query('UPDATE accounts SET connection_id = $1, external_account_id = $2, institution = $4 WHERE id = $3', [connId, EXT_ITAU, itau, 'itau']);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await pool.query('DELETE FROM budgets WHERE id = $1', [B]);
    await pool.query('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = $1', [user.id]);
    await pool.query('DELETE FROM connections WHERE provider = $1', [PROVIDER]);
  });

  test('capture', async () => {
    upstream = TEXTS.map(([d, amount], i) => ({ externalId: `c${i}`, externalAccountId: EXT_ITAU, description: d, amount, date, currencyCode: null, cleared: true, raw: { id: `c${i}` } }));
    const s1 = await sync();
    const s2 = await sync();
    const bulkRows = TEXTS.map(([payee, amount]) => ({ date, payee, memo: '', outflow: -amount, inflow: 0, category_id: null }));
    const b1 = (await op('budget_transactions_bulk_import', { budget_id: B, account_id: savings, txns: bulkRows })).json;
    const b2 = (await op('budget_transactions_bulk_import', { budget_id: B, account_id: savings, txns: bulkRows })).json;
    const names = new Map((await pool.query('SELECT id, name FROM payees WHERE budget_id = $1', [B])).rows.map((r) => [r.id, r.name]));
    const accNames = new Map((await pool.query('SELECT id, name FROM accounts WHERE budget_id = $1', [B])).rows.map((r) => [r.id, r.name]));
    const sync_rows = (await pool.query(
      `SELECT t.import_id, t.amount::int AS amount, p.name AS payee, t.import_payee_name, t.import_payee_name_original, s.last_synced_payload AS shadow, h.account_id AS hint
       FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN payees p ON p.id = t.payee_id LEFT JOIN connection_transactions s ON s.transaction_id = t.id LEFT JOIN transfer_hints h ON h.transaction_id = t.id
       WHERE t.account_id = $1 ORDER BY t.import_id`, [itau])).rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, hint: r.hint ? accNames.get(r.hint) : null }));
    const bulk_rows = (await pool.query(
      `SELECT t.import_id, t.amount::int AS amount, p.name AS payee, t.import_payee_name, h.account_id AS hint
       FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN payees p ON p.id = t.payee_id LEFT JOIN transfer_hints h ON h.transaction_id = t.id
       WHERE t.account_id = $1 ORDER BY t.import_id`, [savings])).rows.map((r) => {
      const m = /^YNAB:(-?\d+):(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}):(.*):(\d+)$/.exec(r.import_id)!;
      return { amount: r.amount, payee: r.payee, import_payee_name: r.import_payee_name, hint: r.hint ? accNames.get(r.hint) : null, key_payee: names.get(m[3]!) ?? m[3], occ: Number(m[4]) };
    });
    const payees = (await pool.query('SELECT name, transfer_account_id, rename_match_type, rename_condition, created_at FROM payees WHERE budget_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at, name', [B])).rows.map((r) => ({ name: r.name, transfer: r.transfer_account_id ? accNames.get(r.transfer_account_id) : null, type: r.rename_match_type, condition: r.rename_condition }));
    writeFileSync(process.env.CAPTURE_OUT!, JSON.stringify({ texts: TEXTS, s1, s2, b1, b2, sync_rows, bulk_rows, payees }, null, 2));
    expect(true).toBe(true);
  });
});
